turns.replyText:
Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Hi, yes, orders can often be canceled after they’re placed, but the best thing to do is contact us as soon as possible since timing depends on how close the order is to shipping.

A few helpful details:

If your order has not shipped yet, we may still be able to cancel it.
If it has already shipped, it can no longer be canceled, but our team may be able to request a recall back to the nursery before delivery. If that recall is successful, there is a $22 per box carrier recall fee.
If a cancellation is processed, the refund goes back to the original payment method. If any portion was paid with a gift card or store credit, that portion is returned to the gift card or store credit.

If you’d like, send me your order number and the email used at checkout, and I can check the current status for you.

Can I change the payment method on my order?

Once an order is placed and you’ve received an order confirmation email, the payment has already gone through and the payment method cannot be changed on that order.

If you’re worried the payment did not work, the confirmation email is your proof that it processed successfully. Our system will not confirm an order if the payment fails.

If this is about a card that has since been lost or reported stolen, as long as the order was placed before you reported the card, the payment will still go through normally and your order will continue as expected.
